articles.summary: In the current political climate, support for our community, staff, and customers remains a top priority for all of us at NaturAll Club. The struggles that face our community are large and ongoing, but through them all, we strive to encourage you and remind you that we are not just a brand, but a family. Here is a compiled list of ways in which you, and those around, can take action to create a real change as our country grapples with issues of police brutality and racial discrimination.
articles.title: Resources to Support The Black Lives Matter Movement and Yourself

articles.summary: Your hair texture is just one part of what makes us totally unique individuals. Plenty of physical attributes are predetermined by genetics. From eye color, to height and bone structure, we all possess visible ties to our family ancestry through genetics. Today we’ll explore why our hair looks the way it does and exactly how the genes you inherit from your parents, and sometimes even your parent’s parents, can determine your hair texture!
articles.title: Where Does Curly Hair Come From?
